planets.name: Kepler-6 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-6 with a 3.23-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: Kepler-6 b was found in 2009 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-6. Its orbit and size follow Esteves et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ESTEVES_ET_AL__2015): disc_year 2009, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.23469918, pl_radj 1.304, pl_bmassj 0.668

quotes.title: Kepler-6b
quotes.card: Kepler-6b is an extrasolar planet in the orbit of the unusually metal-rich Kepler-6, a star in the field of view of the NASA-operated Kepler spacecraft, which searches for planets that cross directly in front of, or transit, their host stars.
quotes.introduction: It was the third planet to be discovered by Kepler.
